newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS Holding 9-month net profit unchanged.
newsitem.headline: CS Holding 9-month net profit unchanged.

text.p: CS Holding said consolidated gross income rose 12 percent in the first nine months of 1996 despite weaker development in the third quarter itself but net income was unchanged from the year-earlier period.

It said third-quarter gross earnings from the three main sources of income -- net income from balance-sheet business, net commission income and trading income -- were all between 3.5 percent and 6.5 percent below the first-half average, but in all rose 18 percent from the first nine months of 1995.
Staff expenses and other operating costs in the third quarter were in line with first-half developments. Overall costs were 18 percent higher than in the first nine months of 1995.
Credit-related provisions were, as expected, higher than for the same period last year, reflecting the Swiss economy's continued sluggishness.
